$description: Sprout sizing tokens for fixed chrome metrics, distilled from webui/src/App.css and component CSS. These are the hard layout constants the shell renders against (header height, terminal strip, sidebar widths, diff row height).

reserved-height.$description: Bottom terminal strip height (reserved even when collapsed).

row-height.$description: Unified diff renderer row height (kept in sync with DiffSurface virtualization).

icon-button.$description: Standard icon control size (header toggles, mode switcher trigger).
